- scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:105-128 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When the jq call on the page count (line 126) fails, page_count is forced to 0 via `|| echo 0`, the page_count < 100 check then returns from the loop even though nothing matched and the runs endpoint may have further pages available. A transient jq failure on a single page prematurely terminates the scan.
  WHY: If jq exits non-zero on a successfully-fetched runs JSON (e.g. malformed `.workflow_runs | length` invocation in some future shell environment), the function returns no match instead of moving to page 2. This is fail-closed, but it can mask matches that exist on later pages.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:743-747, 761 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The wait-plan step has an explicit pre-flight check `if [ -z "${ISSUE_TITLE}" ]; then exit 1; fi` (line 743), but the call site at line 761 passes `"$ISSUE_TITLE"` without the `${:-}` default that the new wait-clarify and wait-implement call sites use (lines 641, 976). The pre-flight makes this safe today, but the inconsistency means a future refactor that drops the pre-flight would silently break the Plan step under `set -euo pipefail`, while Clarify/Implement would keep working.
  WHY: Inconsistent safety semantics between the three call sites; not a regression because the Plan step's pre-flight guard catches it, but a latent fragility.
